subject: Space on left of chart before scale starts when creating a dotchart

messages.author: a9413cb4eedc9e12
messages.subject: Space on left of chart before scale starts when creating a dotchart
parts:
I am trying to graph a dotchart with lines from the y-axis to the points as seen in Cleveland's 1985 book.  I am missing something simple about setting the x-axis.

I even asked this question 5 or 6 years ago and a) got an answer and b) managed to lose my worked example.  Now, when trying to recreate it,  I am doing something stupid.

How do I get rid of that space on the left ?

dat1 <-structure(list(Item = c("Food", "Holiday", "Car", "Council Tax",
    "Other", "Electricity", "Lily", "Books Etc", "Gifts", "Phone BB",
    "House", "Garden", "Clothes"), Expense = c(2600L, 2100L, 1800L,
     1200L, 900L, 850L, 600L, 500L, 500L, 400L, 400L, 150L, 150L)), .Names = c("Item",
     "Expense"), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA,-13L))                                                                      
                                                                                       

chart1 <- ggplot(dat1, aes(Expense, reorder(Item, Expense))) +  geom_point(colour = "red", size = 2) +
     geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = Expense, y = Item, yend = Item))  +
     ggtitle("Breakdown of Expenses") + ylab("Expense Item")

I had thought that  "scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,3000))"  would handle the problem but it is not doing anything that I can see.

Thanks

messages.author: a9413cb4eedc9e12
messages.subject: Re: Space on left of chart before scale starts when creating a dotchart
parts:
Cancel my request. I found the answer. I needed to add expand(0,0) to my cale_x_continuous() statement

Thus

chart1 <- ggplot(dat1, aes(Expense, reorder(Item, Expense))) +  geom_point(colour = "red", size = 2) +
     geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = Expense, y = Item, yend = Item))  +

ggtitle("Breakdown of Expenses") + ylab("Expense Item") +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,3000), expand = c(0, 0))

is giving me exactly what I wanted.
